indicesNarrative: This was a tech-led rout, not a broad liquidation: QQQ -5.90% versus RSP -2.94% and DIA -3.38%, with RSP/DIA/XLF/XLP all carrying RS 100 versus QQQ's RS 5. The rotation is unambiguous — money left megacap growth and semis and parked in staples, healthcare, real estate, financials and long Treasuries. Equal-weight beating cap-weight by ~300bp in a single session is the signature of de-risking out of crowded AI/semis longs.

traderLens.view: Discipline day. No averaging down into semis or crypto-beta, hard stops on anything held, and size cut while Extreme Fear persists. If a stop level isn't defined before entry, there is no entry.

traderLens.view: The only actionable momentum is episodic gaps — APP +29.7% (RVOL 3.86), DNUT +35.4% (RVOL 5.60), XERS +24.6% (RVOL 4.65). Those are ORH-with-LOD-stop day trades, not swing holds, and only on names with a defined catalyst — which this run could not source.

traderLens.name: Composite
traderLens.view: Do nothing on the long side today. Growth/semis are in a confirmed correction, breadth is weak and sentiment is at Extreme Fear — which is not a buy signal by itself. If you must act: half-size momentum day-trades on the gap names with a hard stop, or park in the defensive leadership (XLP/XLV/XLRE/XLF/TLT) and wait for a volume-confirmed reclaim day in QQQ before re-engaging tech.
